title: Bristol Myers ends deal with Cellares, cell therapy manufacturer to reorg
llm_note: Bristol Myers Squibb terminated its manufacturing partnership with Cellares, causing the CDMO to restructure its operations.

title: Lōkahi Therapeutics™ Initiates Clinical Trial Manufacturing for LT-100
llm_note: Lokahi Therapeutics has initiated GMP manufacturing for its LT-100 program.

title: Expanded Synthetic Promoter Library Introduced to Boost Biomanufacturing Operations
llm_note: SynGenSys introduced a synthetic gene promoter system designed to improve commercial protein production in CHO cells.
